raw_content: ### FastAPI mini documentary There's a [FastAPI mini documentary](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mpR8ngthqiE) released at the end of 2025, you can watch it online: ### **Typer**, the FastAPI of CLIs If you are building a CLI app to be used in the terminal instead of a web API, check out [**Typer**](https://typer.tiangolo.com/). **Typer** is FastAPI's little sibling. And it's intended to be the **FastAPI of CLIs**. ⌨️ 🚀
